## ChatGPT subscription support

Midscene supports using your ChatGPT subscription to call GPT models through Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC). For developers who already have a ChatGPT subscription, reusing their subscription allowance can substantially reduce the additional cost of calling GPT models. Sign in with `pnpm dlx @midscene/cli model siwc login`, then configure the access token in Playground or a local `.env` file. See the [ChatGPT subscription guide](https://midscenejs.com/chatgpt-subscription) for model configuration, connection verification, and token refresh.
